title: Native filesystem provenance observation
scope: Observe exact selected native files/relations through the Linux, macOS or Windows provider.
proposed_work_bound: O(N + selected path/attribute bytes + bytes explicitly hashed/read + actual emitted relations) plus indexed ordering. Cross-file relations must not require all-pairs scans for sparse data.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(per-file read window + bounded metadata batches); no whole filesystem inventory unless the declared request is a whole-tree scan.
semantic_requirement: Platform-specific file identity, symlink/reparse handling, source-race evidence and exact attribution maintained.
proposed_witness: Many zero/tiny files and one large file, duplicate payload different identity, rename/race and unsupported native attributes; real platform qualification supplements counters.

title: ExifTool metadata observation
scope: Orchestrate maintained metadata extraction over an exact selected batch.
proposed_work_bound: Repository overhead O(subjects + request/result/metadata bytes), with O(ceil(N/batch)) tool launches. Tool parsing has a pinned format/profile-specific bound to qualify; no universal linear codec/container-parser claim.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Configured subject/tool/output windows, bounded plaintext per active batch; metadata size included in D.
semantic_requirement: Fixed declared metadata fields, conflicts and unsupported outcomes retained; no fabricated complete negatives or provider knowledge in core.
proposed_witness: One metadata process per declared transport batch; large metadata, corrupt containers and repeated facts; measure orchestration separately from tool input processing.

title: FFprobe, magic and media sampling facts
scope: Read/probe selected media and present exact stream/type/sampleable-range facts.
proposed_work_bound: Wrapper O(subjects + read/result bytes); tool decoding/probing described by admitted format/profile. A fixed-header magic profile may bound inspected bytes per member; full media probing may depend on full B/frames, not the tiny answer size.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(configured tools * per-input window) plus declared tool workspace; source plaintext released after each subject when possible.
semantic_requirement: No total-size cutoff disguised as complete inspection; malformed/partial/timeout observations cannot authorize fallback.
proposed_witness: Header vs tail metadata, sparse stream ranges, corrupt or huge metadata, one large file and many short files; count bytes and tool launches.

title: Provenance and materialization-hint observers
scope: Project facts from an authenticated selected member/history set.
proposed_work_bound: O(selected members + unique selected H/V/E + emitted facts) at batch lifecycle scope, plus indexed/canonical costs. Shared history reused without reattributing it; no full collection read per subject.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded batch/concurrency and shared immutable indexes, with cold/evicted paths still correct and declared.
semantic_requirement: Keep member attribution separate from recorded history; fresh per-caller claim/root fences; every selected member covered.
proposed_witness: Many members sharing a large history, independent histories, absent hint, forged source, revocation and cache bypass; count real remote and higher-level construction work.

title: Filename-prefix sidecar matching
scope: Return all exact filename matches and complete/insufficient source statuses.
proposed_work_bound: Propose O(name bytes + S(primary_count+sidecar_count) + Q) deterministic indexed matching, or explicitly expected O(name bytes + primary_count+sidecar_count+Q) with a reviewed hash model. No primary_count*sidecar_count comparisons for one-match-per-sidecar input.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(primary_count+sidecar_count+Q) if API materializes its result, or bounded/paged/spooled equivalent where the protocol allows; Q counts real matches.
semantic_requirement: Exact naming authority, encoding width, root/parent, full-leaf versus stem precedence and ambiguity preserved.
proposed_witness: One sidecar per primary, disjoint names, duplicate stems, mixed naming authorities/encodings, long prefixes and dense legitimate matches.

title: Opus and NVENC media targets
scope: Execute an exact accepted media projection and publish its one derived collection.
proposed_work_bound: Repository overhead O(inputs + outputs + metadata/plan bytes + necessary history/links), plus media processing X(profile,frames,samples,resolution) and G10-G13 publication. No scan of all accepted output decisions per output or full accepted-plan rewrite per item.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded active input/output/pack workspace and configured execution leases; immutable plan O(plan bytes) disk permitted; codec workspace separately declared.
semantic_requirement: Exact output policy, metadata sidecars, source selections, operation identity, CPU/GPU lease authority and publication completion preserved.
proposed_witness: Growing output decisions, tiny vs long audio, fixed vs varying resolution and metadata, host contention/restart; count lookup/serialized bytes independently of ffmpeg time.

title: Shared extension workspaces and retention
scope: Materialize current work, persist bounded progress and retain/reap accepted/status state.
proposed_work_bound: O(bytes actually materialized + output/claim records + expired records) plus indexed lookups. Per-checkpoint state update bounded by delta or explicitly sealed document, not cumulative processed-output bytes.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Fixed configured active workspace/retention budgets; total operational state proportional to retained/live obligations, never total historic completions by accident.
semantic_requirement: Only safe-release receipts permit deletion; leases, failure/cancellation recovery and active readers preserved.
proposed_witness: Multiple pack closures, mid-output kill, expired plus live jobs, reader eviction and completed-record retention; measure high-water RAM/disk and rewritten checkpoint bytes.

title: Review sample-position planning
scope: Choose explicit evenly spaced windows from admitted sampleable spans.
proposed_work_bound: O(total spans + requested windows) after an ordered span input, plus any one S(windows) canonical ordering. Do not rescan all spans for every selected position.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(span index + output windows) for current materialized API; bounded/spooled path required if logical totals cross a declared carrier.
semantic_requirement: Exact sample positions, disjoint/insufficient spans and variant identity remain deterministic.
proposed_witness: One artifact with many spans and many windows; compare exact positions and insufficient-duration errors while counting span visits.

title: Opus/NVENC review samplers
scope: Materialize and execute the exact requested sample windows and variants.
proposed_work_bound: Wrapper O(window/variant incidences + plan/result bytes); codec work charged to decoded samples/frames including required seeks/preroll. No promise O(output bytes) if container/keyframe semantics require more input. Reuse exact source materialization within declared authority.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded active sampling/host-resource windows; per-source metadata and temporary media explicitly accounted.
semantic_requirement: No dropping difficult samples or variants; exact source root/window/intent and failure state retained.
proposed_witness: Many windows in one source, many independent sources, poor-seek containers and host-lease contention; measure decoded/read bytes separately from requested sample duration.

title: Rclone delivery target
scope: Deliver an exact selected result set to a configured external destination.
proposed_work_bound: O(selected members + manifests/evidence bytes + bytes transferred/verified) wrapper work; actual external transfer/listing/hash obligations and retries explicit, not constant time.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Configured transfer/checker concurrency and bounded data windows; no whole-collection duplicate plaintext spool merely for scheduling.
semantic_requirement: Exact destination policy, source selection, delivery receipt and failure semantics; external effect is not a fabricated archive collection.
proposed_witness: Zero/tiny/mixed files, partial external success, resumable transfer, duplicate invocation and destination policy drift; count list/hash/upload operations.
